translations.web: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail is grief; yes, even in the night his heart takes no rest. This also is vanity.
translations.bsb: Indeed, all his days are filled with grief, and his task is sorrowful; even at night, his mind does not rest. This too is futile.
translations.kjv: For all his days are sorrows, and his travail grief; yea, his heart taketh not rest in the night. This is also vanity.
translations.asv: For all his days are but sorrows, and his travail is grief; yea, even in the night his heart taketh no rest. This also is vanity.
